title: Causals: An Open Knowledge Graph for Research on Causal Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.16267v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Applying causal knowledge to a new event requires connecting the event to relevant entities and the relationships through which its consequences may unfold. We present Causals, an open knowledge graph for research on this form of reasoning. Its initial release, constructed from news reports, contains 369,184 nodes and 1,272,418 edges linking reported events, organizations, commodities, financial instruments, and other entities. Structural relationships, observations, and attributed causal claims retain distinct semantics and links to source records. We describe the construction and representation of the resource and characterize its connectivity and multi-hop retrieval properties. Causals provides shared relational knowledge for studying how language models retrieve relevant context and apply mechanisms to particular events. translated_title: Causals：一个用于因果推理研究的开放知识图谱
translated_abstract: 将因果知识应用于新事件，需要将该事件与相关实体以及其后果可能展开的各类关系联系起来。我们提出了Causals，一个面向这类推理研究的开放知识图谱。其初始版本基于新闻报道构建，包含369,184个节点和1,272,418条边，连接了所报道的事件、组织、商品、金融工具及其他实体。结构关系、观察结果和归因的因果声明均保留了各自不同的语义以及与源记录的链接。我们描述了该资源的构建与表示方式，并刻画了其连通性和多跳检索特性。Causals为研究语言模型如何检索相关上下文并将因果机制应用于特定事件提供了共享的关系知识。该数据集以CC BY 4.0许可发布于https://causals.org/，我们欢迎对其本体和记录做出贡献。
tldr: Causals是一个基于新闻报道构建的开放知识图谱，包含超过36万个节点和127万条边，为研究语言模型如何检索相关上下文并将因果机制应用于具体事件提供了共享的关系知识资源。
en_tdlr: Causals is an open knowledge graph built from news reports with 369K nodes and 1.27M edges, providing shared relational knowledge for studying how language models retrieve relevant context and apply causal mechanisms to specific events.
